$comment_top: qgb skill optional hook for Claude Code (Windows native PowerShell). See README.md for opt-in / dry-run / validate / non-destructive merge instructions. DO NOT replace ~/.claude/settings.json with this file; merge the hooks.UserPromptSubmit entry into your existing settings. The {{QGB_SCRIPT_PATH}} placeholder MUST be replaced with the absolute path to scripts/check-relevance.ps1 at install time (see README step 3).

UserPromptSubmit.$comment_matcher_note: matcher is silently ignored for UserPromptSubmit in Claude Code. Filtering happens inside the script (stdin JSON .prompt regex check). The matcher field is intentionally omitted so install-time merge tools do not surface a noisy diff against an unused field.

hooks.$comment_hook: PowerShell script reads stdin (Claude UserPromptSubmit JSON), regex-matches .prompt against the qgb keyword pattern, and emits hookSpecificOutput JSON only on match. Non-match returns empty stdout + exit 0. No filesystem or network side effects. {{QGB_SCRIPT_PATH}} must be an absolute path to scripts/check-relevance.ps1 (see README.md step 3).
